faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is 20th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years for the Anganwadi Worker post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Anganwadi Worker position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the +2 (12th grade) examination to be eligible for the Anganwadi Worker position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Anganwadi Worker post will receive a salary of Rs. 10,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies, comprising 2 for Anganwadi Worker and 4 for Anganwadi Helper posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official WCD Odisha website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an online application followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Does WCD Odisha offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, WCD Odisha offers age relaxation for SC/ST candidates as per the prevailing government rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Official Notification PDF" link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
